The Ultimate Nano-Banana Prompt Guide
Absolutely! ✅ Here is a universal, professional, and engine-agnostic Nano-Banana Prompt Guide — designed so any AI model (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, Perplexity, etc.) can understand and FOLLOW STRICTLY to produce accurate and cinematic visual outputs.
✅ The Ultimate Nano-Banana Prompt Guide
🔥 For ALL Image Generation & Editing AI Models
Nano-Banana = Cinematic Prompting System It teaches AI to understand: 🎯 Subject • 🎥 Camera • 💡 Lighting • 🏞️ Environment • 🎨 Style • 🧩 Identity Consistency → ensuring realistic composition + storytelling in visuals.
✅ 1️⃣ Core Prompt Structure (Mandatory)
Every prompt MUST follow this complete structure:
[Subject]  
[Action / Pose]  
[Environment / Background]  
[Lighting & Mood]  
[Camera & Composition]  
[Style / Art Direction]  
[Details & Attributes]  
[Output Format & Intent]
Example Format:
A young doctor (subject)  
Walking confidently outside a hospital, holding a clipboard (action)  
Modern glass building with greenery (environment)  
Soft cinematic daylight with natural shadows (lighting)  
85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, centered composition (camera)  
Photorealistic, movie poster grade clarity (style)  
Wearing an ID card badge, stethoscope around neck, blue scrubs (details)  
Vertical 4:5 for Instagram profile, clean background for typography (purpose)
✅ When ALL 8 elements exist → results = accurate, cinematic, professional ❌ Missing elements → results = generic + unpredictable
✅ 2️⃣ Best Practices Shield
To guarantee consistently high quality:
Principle
Why it matters
Example
✅ Be Hyper-Specific
Remove ambiguity
“red velvet blazer with gold buttons”
✅ Visual Intent First
AI understands purpose
“for magazine cover hero shot”
✅ Control Camera
Ensures perspective realism
“Low-angle wide shot”
✅ Preserve Physics
Maintain photometric validity
“Matching shadows / reflections”
✅ Identity Consistency
Same face across edits
“Same subject as previous image”
✅ Conversational Refinement
Perfect final result
“Make lighting warmer”
✅ 3️⃣ Nano-Banana Editing Verbs (Image Editing Mode)
When modifying existing images, use one editing verb per instruction:
Verb
Action
Replace Background
Swap full scene
Remove Object
Erase item naturally
Add Object
Insert item w/ correct shadows
Change Outfit
Apply wardrobe realism
Adjust Lighting
Regrade cinematic tone
Enhance Details
Sharpen + color grade
Maintain Identity
Keep face same each edit
Resize/Recompose
Reframe shot professionally
Apply Style
New artistic direction
Composite Multi-Images
Merge people/objects seamlessly
✅ ALWAYS specify preserved elements → “Keep face shape & lighting exactly same.”
✅ 4️⃣ Semantic Negative Prompts (Advanced Rule)
Do NOT ask for what you don’t want Instead: describe opposite desired scene
❌ "No cars" ✅ "Empty street with no signs of traffic"
❌ "Don’t distort face" ✅ "Perfect facial geometry preserved"
✅ 5️⃣ Cinematic Camera Glossary (Use These Words)
Theme
Commands
🎥 Shot Type
close-up, medium shot, wide shot, macro, aerial
📐 Angle
eye-level, low-angle, Dutch tilt, top-down
🔍 Lens
35mm, 50mm, 85mm bokeh, zoom
🚨 Focus
shallow DOF, tack-sharp subject, motion blur
🏞️ Composition
rule of thirds, centered portrait, symmetrical
Using these = instant Hollywood visual language
✅ 6️⃣ Lighting Direction Glossary
Mood
Command Example
Emotional Softness
warm golden hour light
Drama
hard light with deep shadows
Glamour
three-point studio softbox
Urban Neon
red-blue cyberpunk reflections
Dreamlike
volumetric haze, glowing edges
Light defines story ✅ Always include it ✅
✅ 7️⃣ Style System
Category
Examples
Cinematic
Marvel, Christopher Nolan, Denis Villeneuve
Painting
Van Gogh, Renaissance oil, watercolor
Photo Aesthetic
Vogue editorial, National Geographic
Cartoon / 3D
Pixar, Anime cel-shading
Branding
Minimalist product mockup
Pick 1, not too many styles at once.
✅ 8️⃣ Output Configuration (Must Specify)
Always end with:
Aspect ratio (16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 / 1:1)
Resolution (HD / 4K / High-Details)
Use SynthID watermark allowed
To avoid random formats ✅
✅ Master Prompt Template (Copy-Paste)
Works across ALL engines:
[Purpose of the image]
Primary subject: [Detailed subject description]
Pose / Action: [Movement / emotion / interaction]
Environment: [Background + objects + weather]
Lighting: [Mood + source + realism]
Camera & Composition: [Lens, shot type, angle, focus]
Art Style: [Cinematic / artistic direction]
Details: [Wardrobe, textures, accessories, colors]
Continuity Rules: [What must remain identical if editing]
Output Specs: [Aspect ratio + resolution + file intent]
✅ Quick Example (Ultra-Realistic Muslim CEO Portrait)
Corporate magazine cover for a business leader.
Subject: Pakistani Muslim CEO in his mid-30s, well-groomed beard, confident expression
Action: Standing with arms crossed, slight smile
Environment: Modern office skyline behind glass windows
Lighting: Cinematic soft key light + rim light for depth
Camera: 85mm portrait lens, shallow DOF, eye-level shot
Style: Photorealistic Vogue cover look
Details: Navy tailored suit, silver watch, pocket square, subtle bokeh
Continuity Rule: Preserve exact facial identity for sequence editing
Output: 4:5 vertical, print-ready resolution
✅ Photo magazine quality ✅ Usable in campaigns ✅ No guesswork
